name: cavemio-date-picker
title: Date picker
description: One date, typed or picked: the field reads "tomorrow", "next fri" or "4 nov", and the calendar slides by month while one mark glides between days.

cavemio.usage:
import { DatePicker } from "@/components/date-picker";

<DatePicker label="Due" value={due} onValueChange={setDue} min="2026-10-20" />
cavemio.accessibility:
- parseDate(input, today) is exported for your own fields.
- Alt+↓ opens the calendar from the field; the grid uses role="grid" with labelled days.
- Reduced motion: months and the mark change in place.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: – · Called with the new day (null when cleared).

useCases.title: Due dates
useCases.description: Set a task for "next fri" without opening anything.

useCases.title: Bookings
useCases.description: A delivery or appointment day with limits.

useCases.title: Filters
useCases.description: A single "since" date above a report.

features.title: Natural typing
features.description: today, tomorrow, weekdays, "in 3 days/weeks/months", "4 nov", "nov 4", 4/11/2026, ISO.

features.title: Moving mark
features.description: One selection circle thrown between days (420ms).

features.title: Full keyboard
features.description: Arrows by day/week, Page Up/Down by month, Home/End, Enter.

features.title: No time-zone bugs
features.description: Plain YYYY-MM-DD strings in and out.

states.title: typed
states.description: Enter or leaving the field settles the text into a formatted date.

states.title: unreadable
states.description: Red line, a hint of what works, one shake.

states.title: calendar
states.description: Rises off the field; months slide 24px out of a blur (360ms); the month name morphs.

states.title: pick
states.description: The mark glides to the day; the calendar closes and focus returns to the field.
